text: Computer vision is a type of technology that helps computers understand images and videos. One important part is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a person, an animal or an object. Another key part is object detection, which means finding where things are in an image. This technology has many applications in our daily lives. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to see the road, recognise traffic signs and avoid accidents. It is also used in security cameras and medical images. Computer vision is developing quickly and will probably change many industries in the future.
